name: agent-teams
description: Jase's agent teams, one Claude Code plugin per team.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: The shared core dev team: ten roles, fourteen skills and one sixteen-stage milestone loop that build, gate, review, audit and record any app, reading the app's own CLAUDE.md for its specifics.

plugins.name: design-team
plugins.description: The shared design team: a designer who extends the app's design system and writes the hand-off the dev team builds from, and a read-only design-auditor who checks the build against it. Four design skills on the owner's account are referenced, not copied.
